1937, July
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 199 Cont.
July 14 Mrs. Barbara Kelly - 30 - Hopelessly cancerous - according to Drs. She was opened up and found in such condition that they just sewed her to-gether ... has 3 small children and husband.
Page 200 July 14 Richard Stiff - 21 - drowned 11th in the storm ... body lost so far. Virginia Reaume - 34 - T.B. glands now taking x ray treatments .... Mrs. Mary B. Hoffman - Elderly lady - trying to save property Mrs. Nellie Conlon - in doubt Mrs. Dorothy Bucey - 40 - in accident last Saturday - badly hurt - has 4 child ...
Page 201 July 21 Roy Hart - 41 - T.B. not expected to hold more than a week Esther Michaud - 27 - T.B. case now on about 7 yrs. Marie McGuin - about 28 - invalid Lucille Salotka - 9 - sarcomic cancer on shin-bone ....
James Mellon - 58 - in T.B. Northville Wm. Gendron - 45 - leg broken in 4 places - has wife and 2 small Ch
Virginia Mary Biek - 9 - of Kalamzoo - in wheel chair - muscular parplysis
Mrs. Alice Freiberg - 28 - weakened by heat last week, has kidney trouble - has husband and two small child'n depending ... Miss McNamara .... back from Mayo Brs. Thos Duffy .... back broken
